_comment: Film 54 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, ~0.10 USD each, 6 tracks, 2026-11-12). One track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H | 1,2 | 3,M,4 | 5,6 | 7 | 8,A2 + end screen).
style: Instrumental underscore for a thoughtful documentary about artificial intelligence, medicine and the race between finding a cure and proving it. Mystical, awestruck and contemplative: slow evolving drones, soft warm pads, sparse felt piano, glass harmonica and bowed glass, faint choir texture. No drums, no percussion, no vocals, no melody hook, not uplifting or kitschy. Very quiet dynamic range.

M0.mood: a single fragile felt-piano note over a low drone that slowly builds, curiosity and a little unease, a night museum hall with glass cases

M1.chapter: 1, 2 (Amodei, the quote, the essay, C3, cancer)
M1.mood: cool, wondering, slightly uneasy: slowly pulsing pads, sparse piano, glass tones, a laboratory at night, patient and listening; faint rising tension in the second half

M2.mood: deep and slow: a very low gentle pulse like a distant heartbeat without drums, warm low strings, bowed glass; questioning, the answer is faint and hard to hear

M3.mood: the long slow shadow of time: low drones, bowed glass, distant choir texture, patient and a little sorrowful but dignified; second half questioning, gentle tension

M4.mood: clearing and restrained: pads lift slightly, a sparse slow piano figure, warm low strings, quiet hope that stays mysterious

M5.mood: mystical, turns warmer and gently hopeful toward the end; felt piano plays a last slow figure, a faint choir swell, fades out on one long decaying tone
